rules.statement: Don't ask a pull request to move its changelog entries from a new dated version section back under `## [Unreleased]` when the repository cuts the version in the pull request that makes the change, as when a plan's `Release:` line names the version and its last step writes the changelog section.
rules.why: In that workflow the release is published from the newest `CHANGELOG.md` section after the merge, and landing is refused unless that section is the plan's version, so leaving the entries under Unreleased would block the release.
rules.check: Before reporting a dated changelog heading or changed compare links, read the repository's AGENTS.md (the Landing section) and the plan's `Release:` line, and look at how earlier version sections came in. Report only if the repository keeps entries under Unreleased until a separate release step.
